# mtncloud_credentials (Data Source)

Lists your credentials, including those made in the console. Stored credentials integrations and tasks use. Passwords and keys are never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_credentials" "all" {}

output "credentials" {
  value = { for x in data.mtncloud_credentials.all.credentials : x.id => { name = x.name, type = x.type } }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_regex` (String) Only return credentials whose name matches this regular expression (RE2 syntax), for example `^web-`.

### Read-Only

- `credentials` (Attributes List) The credentials, sorted by name, then ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is enabled.
- `id` (Number) ID of the credential.
- `name` (String) Name of the credential.
- `type` (String) Credential type, for example `Username and Password`.
- `username` (String) User name, or empty.
